title: System status
operatorScope: The operator configures the server address and credential storage.
retryBackend: PaperWrench is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
configurePaperless: Paperless is unconfigured. Ask the operator to set its address.
checkCredentials: Paperless rejected authentication. Check your token in Account or sign in again.
checkPaperless: Paperless is unreachable. Check that it is running, then retry.
checkVersion: The Paperless API is incompatible. Ask the operator to check the installed version.
